title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: Live evidence: delegated mission MSN_01M4PGEKGX97NGQJJEM971GYSZ failed at planning — FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING (delegated missions have no pinned/llm_plan, so the template fallback emitted no TELEGRAM_DELIVERY and bypassed the DELIVERY_TASK_INJECTED seam inside canonicalizeLlmTasks). Fix: extracted the block into injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission — ONE shared authority called by canonicalize AND the template fallback; reconcilePlanDataflow re-stamps instruction/manifest/contract/language/edges. Template T2 no longer embeds the goal (delivery clause in a work instruction trips hygiene+semantic gates). Mandate's preferred path (whole list through canonicalize) documented incompatible: hygiene on embedded goal + assertPlanCoverage obligations → MISSING becomes PLAN_INCOMPLETE. Preserved: persisted/pinned replay, replan seam, validate/assert/digest pinning, fail-closed unservable, forged PAIR_DELIVERY_INJECTION_KEY stripped+re-stamped only on PAIR task, single injection impl. Tests 20/20 (R1 audit gaps closed test-side, zero prod edits): BEFORE reproduces MISSING, AFTER commits [T1,T2,T3:TELEGRAM_DELIVERY]; F1 full-stack integration — delegated mission drives real MissionRuntime+adapter to COMPLETED, mints TEXT request (digest-pinned payload, provenance bound), governed bridge transport with recording fake: isAllowed consulted, one send to bound chat, SENT+attempt ledger receipt, idempotent; deny-path → UNSENDABLE zero calls; F2 external-input binding provenance fields + consumed artifact + producer edges + manifest + drift fail-closed + idempotent replay; F3 forged stamp stripped through real canonicalize seam (incl. delivery-shaped raw task); FALSE intent zero; unservable fails closed. Regressions pass; baseline: pair-f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash fails on BASE cf2674c (unrelated).
